messages.subject: Re: bootstrap in SEM with missing data : bsBootMiss-how you get CI of correlations (paths) between variables?
parts:
bsbootmiss() is for testing model fit.  Standard bootstrapping (in lavaan) is sufficient for testing individual parameters.
